project.title: 文案进，成片出——结构给知识视频说服力

timing.method: derive_timing.py from word-level ASR (narration-v3.mp3 / 解说小明, sensevoice)
timing.note: 所有 startSec/keywords.atSec 均由词级时间戳推导：场景边界=子句间停顿中点，beat=关键词 token 起点。禁止手工覆盖。

scenes.narration: 一篇文案，怎么变成一支让人看完的知识视频？
scenes.visualSubject: Document card on the left transforms into a hand-drawn play-button film frame on the right, pen leading every stroke

beats.action: headline underline draws itself
document card outline draws (spoken 文案)
arrow starts drawing toward film frame
frame strokes complete on spoken 知识视频, play button follows

scenes.narration: 先读懂文案，找到它真正的论证结构。
scenes.visualSubject: Document is re-read: key sentences get hand-drawn brackets that resolve into a claim-evidence skeleton

beats.action: doc card slides to left column
bracket strokes mark sentences (spoken 读懂文案)
skeleton lines draw (claim box + evidence node) on spoken 论证结构

scenes.narration: 再把文案切成六到八秒的语义分镜，每个分镜，只讲一个意思。
scenes.visualSubject: One long timeline bar is cut into three 6-8s segments, each segment gets a single-idea label stamped by the pen

beats.action: long bar draws across frame
two scissor strokes cut the bar (spoken 切成)
6-8s ticks and labels draw on spoken 语义分镜
one-idea dot lands in each segment on spoken 一个意思

scenes.narration: 然后按语义，为每个分镜找画面：能画出来的，直接画；需要证据的，去找真实的照片和视频。
scenes.visualSubject: Two branches draw from the timeline: left branch pens a small sketch icon (能画的直接画), right branch pins a REAL photo of a vintage film camera (需要证据找真实素材)

assets.description: 一台真实的复古胶片相机，作为「需要证据就找真实照片和视频」的画面证据

beats.action: branch fork draws from timeline node
branch labels draw on spoken 找画面
left branch: pen draws sketch icon on spoken 直接画
right branch: tape strips draw (spoken 需要证据)
REAL photo pins in with hand-drawn arrow on spoken 照片和视频

scenes.narration: 最后配音、上字幕、合成，一遍跑完。
scenes.visualSubject: Three pipeline nodes (配音/字幕/合成) draw and connect in sequence, then progress strokes sweep the whole pipeline on spoken 一遍跑完

beats.action: node 1 配音 draws (spoken 配音)
node 2 字幕 draws, connector to node 1
node 3 合成 draws, connector completes
progress underline sweeps whole pipeline on spoken 一遍跑完

scenes.narration: 文案进，成片出。说服力来自结构，而不是特效。
scenes.visualSubject: Payoff 文案 → 成片 boxed in accent on spoken 成片; then big statement 说服力 ← 结构 with skeleton echo behind; the word 特效 draws in then gets a hand-drawn cross-out on spoken 特效

beats.action: payoff 文案 → 成片 draws (spoken 文案进)
accent box closes around 成片 on spoken word
说服力 draws large, underline sweeps on spoken word
← 结构 draws with mini skeleton echo behind on spoken 结构
特效 draws in muted gray
accent cross-out strokes through 特效 on spoken word

scenes.finalState: Statement with crossed-out 特效 holds 1.9s
